title: TC-FedIDS: Trajectory-Aware Trust and Environment-Risk Aggregation for Heterogeneous Federated Intrusion Detection
description: Code, measured results, figures and tables for TC-FedIDS, a trajectory-aware aggregation framework for heterogeneous federated intrusion detection. TC-FedIDS maintains a five-round history of each client's updates, derives four temporal descriptors (direction persistence, update-norm entropy, second-order acceleration, update-norm variance), and fuses them with geometric deviation, environment alignment and validation residuals into continuous trust weights. These weights are used as soft coefficients in a Huber-regularised GroupDRO objective solved with bounded FISTA. The evaluation uses 28 clients across four NetFlow environments (NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018, NF-ToN-IoT, UNSW-NB15, CIDDS-001) under Dirichlet non-IID partitioning, with clean, ALIE, sign-flip and Gaussian-noise settings over ten seeds.
